findings.title: Unsigned HTTP update cannot authenticate executable provenance
findings.evidence: Checksum and archive come from the same HTTP endpoint; architecture-compatible attacker bytes can replace the executable. Runtime warning and review-dispositions-0049.json explicitly disclose this inherited boundary.
findings.disposition: No scope expansion in this development audit. Production needs independent authenticated update authorization. Development activation still requires out-of-band approval of the exact payload hash.

standards.pairing_finding: Resolved. Exact pending ID and loopback management authorization protect rejection. The approving guard is set before filesystem awaits. Rejection changes no content credential, stale IDs cannot affect replacement requests, and browser origins are refused.
standards.result: No new source-level blocker or actionable heuristic smell identified. Production and full acceptance remain blocked.
